overview.title: Village and Bay on the Park Edge
overview.p1: Cala Iris sits on the western park coast: a small fishing settlement and an open bay that feels far from the city.
overview.p2: The road can be slow; plan time and a driver who knows the route.
overview.p3: Often combined with Torres de Alcalá or other park viewpoints in one coastal day.

q1.question: How far from Al Hoceima?
q1.answer: On the park coast west of the city; allow time for the coastal road.

q2.question: Is it good for swimming?
q2.answer: Yes when conditions allow; more open and wild than city beaches.

q4.question: Do I need a guide?
q4.answer: A local driver is more useful than a hiking guide for most visitors.

q5.question: Combine with other stops?
q5.answer: Yes — often with Torres de Alcalá or Bades.
